# Emailvalidation

Validate individual email addresses for deliverability and quality signals, and inspect account quota usage through emailvalidation.io's complete REST API surface.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/emailvalidation/.

## Actions

- **Get Account Quota Status** (read-only): Return the connected emailvalidation.io account ID and current monthly and grace credit totals, usage, and remaining balances.
- **Validate Email Address** (read-only): Validate one email address and return deliverability, format, mailbox, domain, role-address, disposable-address, and quality signals.
